title: Mayar and Driesh, Glen Clova
listingBlurb: Two Munros from Glen Clova — big ridges, obvious shape, not a puzzle.
summary: Two-Munro round via Glen Clova (Walkhighlands line in the attached GPX): onto open ground, along the broad ridge through Mayar and Driesh, back. Straightforward in clear weather. weatherNote.title: Before you go
weatherNote.body: Use a mountain forecast for the ground you’re on, not just the town. Ridges can howl when the glen looks calm.
weatherNote.supporting: This page doesn’t update — check live conditions.

whyThisRoute.title: Why pick this day?
whyThisRoute.body: Decent shout when the weather’s rough or you don’t want a nav exam. Height, air, ridge that mostly reads itself — less head-scratching than the fiddlier Glen Esk days.
callouts: Two Munros, obvious ridge logic in decent vis.
Big hill day without inventing new hobbies.
whyThisRoute.supporting: Nasty weather it’s still a slog — wind, clag, tired legs. Nav’s just usually kinder than the loose link-ups.

recommendationBlock.title: Rough take
lines: Easy day in the glen to picture — big open ground, not much mystery if you can see.
Leave the clever linking for another day unless you want extra map work.
recommendationBlock.supporting: Late starts work more here than on tight days — still mind sunset and winter light.

qualityMeter.headline: Solid day out with a readable shape
qualityMeter.verdict: Big and open, nav usually fine in clear weather. Still a hill day, not a wander round Asda.

whatDayFeelsLike.title: What it feels like
whatDayFeelsLike.body: Big sky, solid hill underfoot, mostly straightforward. Find a pace, lunch out of the wind if you can, still earn your tea.
whatDayFeelsLike.supporting: Clag and wind turn it serious quick — no tricks, just exposure and legs. Know how you’d shorten it before you need to.
summaryLines: Headspace for chat or silence — your call.

terrainDetail.title: Terrain & vibe
terrainDetail.body: Grass and heather low down, cleaner ridge higher. Normal Scottish mix: wet bits, draggy bits, nice bits if the light plays ball.
terrainDetail.supporting: Winter’s a different job — ice, slab, short days; same respect as any Munro day.

goodStopsDetail.intro: Break spots that usually work — not waypoints, just habit.

spots.title: Somewhere out of the worst wind
spots.description: On the ridge, a slight dip or lee side beats lunch on the highest lump.

spots.title: Before anything committing
spots.description: If the clag comes down, slow up and check the map there — not after you’ve already committed to a vague downhill guess.

anchorRefsIntro: Labels for chat and map checks — not a sequence to march.
notes: Suits rough-but-readable weather, sensible late starts, ridge nav when you can see — not clag heroics.
Estate access, events, and parking rules change — read the signs.
Busy in good weather; go early or late if crowds annoy you.
